'''Álex Somoza''' (born 7 July 1986) is an Andorran international [[association football|footballer]] who plays club football for [[FC Andorra]], as a [[midfielder]]. Today is coach of [[Inter Club d'Escaldes]].<ref>[https://www.elperiodic.ad/entrevista/57319/alex-somoza-a-la-banqueta-pateixes-molt-mes-que-al-camp Entrevista Àlex Somoza, entrenador de l'Inter d'Escaldes]</ref>

==Career==
Somoza has played club football for  [[FC Santa Coloma]], [[CE Principat]], [[FC Rànger's]], [[CD Binéfar]] and [[FC Andorra]].<ref name = "NFT">{{NFT player|pid=13090}}</ref>

He made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2006,<ref name = "NFT"/> and has appeared in FIFA World Cup qualifying matches for them.<ref>{{FIFA player|217273}}</ref>
